clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, promising rogues begin training with the Shattered Hand. Trainer Shenthul sends his chosen initiate to meet Zando'zan and enter the Horde's covert ranks.

Orgrimmar's rulers know brute strength cannot win every war. Beneath the city, the Cleft of Shadow houses the Shattered Hand, a covert guild that handles espionage, sabotage, and theft for the Horde. When rogue trainer Shenthul sees promise in an initiate, he sends them to report to Zando'zan for dedicated operative training.

Zando'zan does not grant respect to every inexperienced rogue who enters the cavern. Meeting him marks a formal initiation into the finer clandestine arts, beginning with stealth, subterfuge, and thievery. His training bridges the distance between rough street cutpurses and organized intelligence operatives, preparing rogues for fieldwork beyond the safety of the capital's red canyon walls.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your determination alone is not enough to overcome the obstacles that lay ahead of us.
Speak with Zando'zan to begin your training as an operative of the Shattered Hand.
It is only when you have mastered the practices of stealth and thievery that you may take the next step towards your destiny.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Perhaps Zando'zan was wrong. Zando'zan apologizes.
